description: This file implements the MainThread class and related factory functions for managing a dedicated main thread, including client registration, task queue management, and thread lifecycle control within the Rialto server component.

classes.name: MainThread
classes.description: Manages a dedicated thread executing queued tasks, handles client registration/unregistration, and maintains thread lifecycle.

classes.name: MainThread::TaskInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a task scheduled for execution, including client ID, task function, synchronization primitives.

classes.name: MainThreadFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and retrieving singleton instances of MainThread.

classes.name: IMainThread
classes.description: Interface for MainThread, providing abstraction for thread management.

classes.name: IMainThreadFactory
classes.description: Interface for factory creating MainThread instances.

methods.name: MainThread::mainThreadLoop
methods.description: Main loop executing tasks from the queue until shutdown signal.

methods.name: MainThread::waitForTask
methods.description: Blocks until a task is available in the queue and returns it.

methods.name: MainThread::registerClient
methods.description: Registers a new client and returns its assigned client ID.

methods.name: MainThread::unregisterClient
methods.description: Unregisters a client by its ID.

methods.name: MainThread::enqueueTask
methods.description: Adds a task to the queue for a specific client.

methods.name: MainThread::enqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Enqueues a task and waits for its completion.

methods.name: IMainThreadFactory::createFactory
methods.description: Creates a new factory instance for MainThread.

methods.name: MainThreadFactory::getMainThread
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton MainThread instance, creating it if necessary.
